At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

Are you an experienced commercial professional looking for an environment where your ideas matter, decisions move quickly, and your direct contribution makes a visible impact?

We built Trustpilot to be that place.

As AI reshapes how consumers search, discover, and choose brands, Trustpilot’s unique dataset of authentic human sentiment is becoming increasingly critical. We are uniquely positioned to define how trust and reputation function in an AI-driven digital economy and we’re building an inclusive environment where curious, ambitious people can do the best work of their careers.

We’re expanding our Enterprise business across the French market, and we’re looking for collaborative, forward-thinking professionals to help shape what’s next. You’ll work with some of the region’s leading brands at a moment when AI is fundamentally changing how reputation is built and how consumers make decisions, while helping businesses use authentic human sentiment to strengthen their visibility, credibility, and competitive position in the AI economy.

If you’re energised by building new approaches, solving complex challenges, and seeing the tangible impact of your work, we’d love to hear from you.

This role requires native-level French and strong professional English language skills. It is based in our Copenhagen office.

What you’ll be doing:

• Drive Portfolio Value: Manage a portfolio of Enterprise accounts across the French market, owning customer retention, guiding successful renewals, and identifying growth opportunities through thoughtful account mapping.

• Partner for Success: Work in close partnership with dedicated Customer Success Managers (CSMs). While you lead on commercial strategy, contract growth, and negotiations, your CSM partner guides adoption, implementation, and ongoing account health, delivering a seamless, high-value experience for our clients.

• Help Build the Playbook: Bring fresh perspectives to a growing function by sharing market insights, piloting retention and expansion initiatives, and co-creating our France Enterprise strategy.

• Demonstrate Value: Deeply understand client business goals and metrics to deliver measurable ROI, establishing Trustpilot as a trusted, long-term partner.

Who you are:

• Native-level French and strong professional English language skills

• Demonstrated track record managing Enterprise-level customer portfolios, with experience driving renewals, account retention, and commercial expansion within a SaaS or subscription-based environment.

• Comfortable navigating evolving environments, taking ownership of your outcomes, and eager to help shape an Enterprise approach rather than simply following a rigid process.

• Proven ability to co-manage complex customer relationships alongside Customer Success Managers, technical leads, and cross-functional teams.

• Skilled at leading thoughtful, consultative conversations with senior leadership and key stakeholders across diverse organizations.

• Excited to move beyond standard sales approaches and help tailor solutions that truly resonate within the European market.

What’s in it for you:

• Real ownership: influence how we grow within your market

• Competitive compensation package + bonus

• 25 days holiday with an additional 5 days after 12 months of continuous employment

• 2 (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community

• Paid parental leave

• Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health

• An international workspace at our HQ in Copenhagen that’s complete with a coffee bar and canteen, with a wide variety of refreshments available. You can opt in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price.

Still not sure?

We want to be a part of creating a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive world of work for all. We’re excited to hear about your experiences along with how you will contribute to our working culture. Even if you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, we'd still really like to hear from you!

About us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in  Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

Join us at the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.

_Trustpilot is a global company and our data practices are designed to ensure that your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that your personal information will be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in our Privacy Policy.

If you have a disability and would like to discuss any adjustments you might need either in submitting your application, or to the recruitment process more generally, please let us know by contacting our Talent Acquisition Team (talent.acquisition@trustpilot.com)  quoting the role you wish to apply for._

Are you ready to shape the future of airport automation and collaborate with global team members to ensure seamless integration of complex systems? As a Senior Automation Engineer at BEUMER Group, you will take ownership of mission critical projects for baggage handling solutions in major airports worldwide. Leveraging your deep technical expertise, you ensure our systems keep millions of passengers moving safely and efficiently every day.

To further expand and strengthen our team in Airport Automation we are seeking an experienced Senior Automation Engineer to join our team. You will become part of the Project Engineering team, consisting of 12 highly skilled colleagues. The team is dedicated to working with our CrisBag system for some of the world's largest airports, which also means that if in your interest, traveling will be possible. Our systems operate around the clock and handle millions of bags annually, placing high demands in reliability, scalability and maintainability. Together with the team, you’ll bring tomorrow’s automation solutions to life with immediate access to our in-house test centre for prototyping, simulation, and validation.

Explore the CrisBag baggage handling system here.

Play a crucial part in developing cutting-edge technology for project delivery

As Senior Automation Engineer, we expect you to act as a technical authority, identifying opportunities for enhancement in existing systems and processes. You will work across the full automation stack including PLC, safety systems, network infrastructure, high-level system integration, commissioning and cross-disciplinary technical coordination. As an essential part of the role you will contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes, development tools, simulation and emulation environments, testing methodologies, and software quality practices. You will participate in project definition and review meetings. Your tasks include but are not limited to:

• Developing PLC code for projects specific elements and solutions in our baggage handling system

• Defining the best solutions for specific projects

• Commissioning your PLC code in projects worldwide as well as testing your solutions virtually or at our test centre

• Reviewing layouts and solutions early in the process to secure the long-term success of our projects

• Mentor team members in code development, promoting best practices and knowledge-sharing

• Participating in the documentation of our solutions

Skilled Automation Engineer

We appreciate an inclusive mindset and the desire to be a part of a highly dedicated team, driven by the technology and world class products. We value curiosity, practical creativity, and engineers who think beyond code to create the best solutions. Moreover, we are looking for someone with the following qualifications:

• Advanced proficiency in Siemens TIA and SCL (Structured Control Language)

• Solid experience with modular software development, component-based architectures and structured PLC programming

• Speak and write English fluently

Furthermore, we expect that you possess strong coordination skills, in providing inputs for planning and resources. You thrive in a dynamic environment, and hold a proactive, detail-oriented mindset, enabling you to effectively manage multiple priorities and collaborate across teams.

Culture at BEUMER

At BEUMER, we focus on creating a culture that supports both personal and professional growth. We encourage employees to explore new career paths and internal opportunities along the way. We value teamwork, and open collaboration. Our way of working is built on trust and respect for one another.

Maintaining a healthy work–life balance is a priority to us, which is why we offer flexible working options and up to two remote workdays per week. As a family-owned company, we also think long term, which means prioritizing stability, employee well-being, and strong, trust-based relationships. Further, we offer a wide range of social activities, such as padel tennis, fitness facilities, gaming, biking club and much more.

Interested?

If you have any questions regarding this position, please contact Head of Project Execution, Airport Engineering Poul Madsen on +45 5138 1904. We interview on an ongoing basis.

BEUMER Group

Conveying, loading, palletising, packing, sortation, and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. They can do this because they know the industry and are passionate about continuously developing and expanding their knowledge. We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect and a work culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all of our employees. Our common goal is to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide

Join DynamicsPrint: A Leading Microsoft Preferred Solution for the Printing and Packaging Industry

DynamicsPrint has pioneered a Microsoft-preferred solution that is recognized as a preferred choice for the printing and packaging industry. Grounded in Microsoft 365 FO, our ISV solution covers every aspect, from quoting and production to resource planning and finance. Since our establishment in 1993, we have dedicated ourselves to the printing industry, accumulating invaluable insights and expertise. Fused with cutting-edge Microsoft technology, our knowledge positions us as trusted advisors and technology partners for the world’s leading printing companies.

ERP Consultant – Implementation

International Customers – Growing Industry – Strong Vertical Solution

We are seeking an experienced ERP Consultant with expertise in production planning to join our team. As a pivotal member of our company, you will be responsible for implementing and optimizing ERP systems, focusing specifically on production processes within the print and packaging industry.

In your role as an Implementation Consultant, you will report directly to the Consultant Manager and engage with our exciting customers in the print and packaging industry. Your primary responsibilities will include conducting GAP analysis, system specifications, manage on-site implementation, training super users, and coordinating with stakeholders. Your key responsibilities will involve:

• Conducting GAP analysis and pre-analysis on-site to understand the capabilities of both the standard solution and DynamicsPrint, identifying needs and potential gaps.

• Managing system implementation and onboarding.

• Facilitating user training and ensuring a smooth transition to the new systems for employees.

• Provide continuous support and make ongoing improvements to ERP solutions based on the company’s evolving needs.

• Collaborating with clients and stakeholders in the print and packaging sector to ensure that the solutions meet expectations and deliver tangible value.

• Coordinating with stakeholders (customers and partners).

• Learning and adapting quickly, with the expectation to independently manage projects after initial guidance in collaboration with internal and external project managers and developers.

What We’re Looking For:

Specialist, manager from the print industry or consultant with ERP experience.

You should have a strong background from the printing industry or ERP systems, excelling in functional expertise and communication, demonstrating the ability to quickly learn and adapt in dynamic environments. An as individual, you’re characterized by your ability to manage diversity, work independently, and possess adaptability, teamwork, quick learning, and good communication skills. Experience with relevant print software or ERP software such as Microsoft, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar is preferred, especially with a focus on supply chain, production planning and optimization. Your experience may come from roles as pre-press, other specialist functions or middle management in the printing and packaging industry, or an internal or external ERP consultant. Ideally, you have a relevant education within graphical design/production, a degree in economics, IT, or a related field. We offer a competitive salary package and the opportunity to join a team of highly ambitious and talented individuals based in Farum, or in a hybrid/remote setup.

We offer:

• An exciting opportunity to work with leading companies and complex projects within the print and packaging industry.

• A dynamic, diverse, and collaborative work culture.

• Opportunities for professional and personal development.

• To be part of a customer centric growth journey.

Learn more about DynamicsPrint at the DynamicsPrint Website

Information

Our technical OT/ICS team is expanding, so we're looking for a senior technical consultant to join an ambitious cybersecurity team working with clients across the globe.

What you'll do

You'll join a team of highly skilled engineers and consultants working at the intersection of IT, Operational Technology (OT), automation, and cybersecurity – with protecting and monitoring OT networks at the core of what we do.

In this role, you'll own:

• 
Advanced threat detection and engineering: working extensively with industry-leading technology providers to deploy, test, and tune advanced threat monitoring solutions in production environments

• 
Technical implementation: leading the design and implementation of OT network segmentation projects, architecture redesign, secure remote access integration, and asset/configuration analysis

• 
Consultancy and advisory: acting as trusted advisor to clients and colleagues on architecture reviews and OT risk assessments, and translating technical risk into business impact

What you'll bring

We're looking for a seasoned OT Cybersecurity Principal Consultant with extensive experience in infrastructure solutions and technology deployment in OT environments.

The ideal candidate comes with:

• 
At least 5 years of experience in OT/ICS cybersecurity, including client-facing consulting roles

• 
Demonstrated capability across critical security domains such as network segmentation, IDS/IPS, endpoint security, secure remote access, incident response, cyber threat intelligence, and Security Operations Centre enablement

• 
A track record of continuous technical development — for example, certifications such as GICSP, GRID, ISA/IEC, CCNA/CCNP, or product certifications with recognised OT security vendors such as Nozomi or Claroty

Clearance for SECRET (HEMMELIGT) with Danish authorities is a plus.

What we offer

We're a growing and ambitious tech startup that puts technical excellence first. We invest in the tools, tradecraft, and certifications needed to stay at the forefront of our domains, and continuously sharpen our expertise.

You'll join a team of highly skilled specialists working on complex OT cybersecurity challenges, helping shape both our capabilities and the services we bring to market.

About The Tech Collective

The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We aim to make a positive difference in the consulting industry, believing that the ability to create change with impact and purpose is a prerequisite for success in a global and turbulent world.

For any questions about the position, contact Anders Rømer at anrs@thetechcollective.eu.

On behalf of our client, Anticimex Innovation Center, Asgaard Recruitment is seeking a Senior Firmware Engineer to strengthen the firmware engineering team and contribute to the development, improvement, and industrialization of smart, connected products operating in demanding real-world environments.

Anticimex is a global leader in modern pest control and prevention. At Anticimex Innovation Center, ideas move from sketch to prototype to smart devices that transform pest control into a data-driven and more sustainable industry.

The role

As Senior Firmware Engineer, you will take a central role in developing and improving the firmware that brings connected devices to life, working closely with electronics, mechanics, and software/cloud teams to ensure that hardware and firmware perform reliably together.

The role combines hands-on firmware development with technical leadership. You will help set the professional standard for firmware design, support task coordination within the team, and contribute to stronger engineering practices across design reviews, release discipline, root-cause analysis, testing, documentation, and change management.

A key part of the role will be to help strengthen in-house firmware capabilities. Today, parts of the firmware development are handled by external partners, and Anticimex Innovation Center is now building stronger internal ownership of selected design, verification, and development activities.

You will work with embedded firmware for battery-powered IoT devices, low-power wireless connectivity, over-the-air updates, and production test support. The position is primarily based in Bagsværd. Some occasional travel to Helsinge expected to stay close to production, products, and technical problem-solving. Also, regular presence at the HQ of our strategic partner Sigma Connectivity in Lund, Sweden to be expected.

Your key responsibilities

You will:

• 
Develop and improve firmware for low-power, wireless IoT devices, from bring-up through production release

• 
Lead the structured transition of selected firmware development and verification activities from external partners to internal ownership, including tooling, documentation, and knowledge transfer

• 
Own firmware architecture in selected projects, including driver development, wireless connectivity stacks, and over-the-air (OTA) update mechanisms

• 
Contribute to verification and validation activities, including hardware/firmware bring-up, test planning, troubleshooting, certification readiness, and release processes

• 
Strengthen Stage-Gate execution, design review practices, documentation quality, engineering change processes, and controlled releases

• 
Collaborate closely with firmware architect, electronics, mechanics, software/cloud, production colleagues, internal stakeholders, and external suppliers

You will become a key technical voice in the firmware discipline, helping raise the engineering standard and ensuring that products are designed not only to work, but to work reliably at scale.

Who you are

You are an experienced firmware engineer with deep technical expertise and a strong interest in building connected products for the real world. You enjoy hands-on embedded development, structured problem-solving, and turning technical findings into robust, production-ready solutions.

You likely bring:

• 
7–10+ years of experience in embedded firmware development

• 
Strong experience with embedded C/C++ and real-time operating systems (e.g. FreeRTOS, Zephyr) or bare-metal development

• 
Experience with battery-powered IoT devices and low-power wireless connectivity (e.g. BLE, LoRaWAN, or cellular IoT)

• 
Experience with firmware architecture, driver development, and over-the-air (OTA) update mechanisms

• 
Experience with version control, automated testing, and CI/CD for embedded systems

• 
Experience working in structured product development models such as Stage-Gate

• 
Knowledge of security practices for connected devices (Ideally RED+CRA)

• 
Professional proficiency in English

It is an advantage if you have experience with insourcing or transitioning development work from external partners, hardware bring-up and debugging (JTAG/SWD), cellular or LoRaWAN certification processes, PDM/PLM systems, ISO 9001, FMEA, or cloud/IoT platform integration.

Why Anticimex Innovation Center

Anticimex Innovation Center is at a pivotal moment. Moving from a fast-moving scale-up approach toward a more professional and scalable product-development organization, without losing agility.

Today, Anticimex has around 600,000 connected devices deployed globally, creating both strong proof of success and a need to further mature engineering practices, product robustness, and long-term ownership.

You will join an organization with strong ambitions, short decision paths, and real opportunities to influence how products are designed, improved, tested, documented, and industrialized. You will help raise the technical level of the firmware discipline and play an important part in building more scalable in-house development capabilities.

Is this you?

If you are motivated by embedded firmware development, low-power connected devices, technical problem-solving, and the opportunity to help shape the next generation of intelligent pest control solutions, we would like to hear from you.

We review applications continuously and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.

Want to gain practical management consulting experience while completing your degree? We’re looking for a junior consultant eager to help some of Europe’s most ambitious and critical organisations turn geopolitical instability, cyber threats, regulatory pressure, and fragile supply chains into a competitive advantage.

What you’ll do

As a Junior Consultant within Implement's growing Security & Resilience team, you'll join more than 25 consultants specialising in security transformation, OT & critical infrastructure, resilience, and AI security & governance. You'll help our clients enhance their resilience and security posture so they can thrive even in times of crisis.

Working alongside experienced consultants, you will:

• Research emerging threats, regulations and industry developments

• Analyse complex security and resilience challenges

• Support risk assessments, scenario analyses and maturity evaluations

• Help develop strategies, governance models and practical recommendations

• Prepare workshops, presentations and decision-making material for clients

• Contribute to proposals and the development of new approaches and services

You’ll be trusted with meaningful responsibility from the beginning. Your ideas and perspectives will matter, and you will receive the support and feedback you need to grow.

What you’ll bring

We're looking for people with curiosity, commitment, and a genuine willingness to learn. The role is designed for students, which means your studies come first and we will plan your workload accordingly.

We’re looking for someone who:

• Is enrolled in a relevant higher education programme, typically at master’s level and is among the best in their class

• Studies engineering, computer science, business, political science, security studies, or a related field

• Has a strong interest in security, resilience, risk, cybersecurity, or critical infrastructure

• Demonstrates analytical and conceptual problem-solving skills

• Communicates complex ideas clearly, both verbally and in writing

• Works collaboratively and contributes positively to a team

• Is comfortable taking ownership, including when there is no ready-made solution

On top of that, it’s an advantage – but not a requirement – if you have one or more of the following:

• Familiarity with security, resilience, or risk management concepts and frameworks

• Awareness of frameworks such as ISO 27001, 42001, etc., or the NIST Cybersecurity Framework

• Awareness of EU regulation such as CER, NIS2, DORA, or the Cyber Resilience Act

• Strong quantitative skills relevant to risk scenarios and data-driven assessments

• Experience from case competitions, student consulting, or other extracurricular activities

• An interest in geopolitics, critical infrastructure, or organisational crisis response

We don’t expect you to know everything from day one. What matters most is your curiosity, learning mindset, and motivation to contribute.

You can expect to work approximately 15–20 hours per week, with flexibility during exams and intensive study periods. On top of contributing to client engagements, you can expect to participate in our dedicated development programme for junior consultants.

What we offer

At Implement, you'll get meaningful client exposure from day one, working on real assignments involving complex, high-impact challenges. You'll receive close mentorship, frequent feedback, and paid, relevant training, as part of one of our four Security & Resilience communities, collaborating across specialisms.

The role is built around flexibility, so you can build genuine consulting experience without compromising your studies. And as befits an employee-owned consultancy, you'll be joining a strong company culture where we believe lasting change is created through people.

Make your next move matter.

About Implement Consulting Group

Implement Consulting Group (founded 1996) is an international management consultancy with over 1,900 employees, making it one of the largest European consultancies. Headquartered in Copenhagen, the company has offices across the Nordics, the DACH region, and the United States. Implement supports organisations in delivering sustainable strategic, commercial, and operational transformations. The company combines analytical rigour, functional expertise, and industry insight with a unique collaborative model and an ability to engage and mobilise client organisations.

Company Description

Are you the one who brings structure when things get complex, and who walks over to ask why something has stalled rather than waiting for an email? Then you might be the Student Assistant we are looking for!

At JYSK, our Operational Centre of Excellence helps teams across IT and the business units it supports work in more stable and measurable ways. We are looking for a Student Assistant for 15 hours a week to work with data and stakeholder coordination at JYSK Head Office in Aarhus.

You start as soon as we have found the right candidate. For the first six weeks you work about one day a week, then 15 hours a week over two days, with at least one of them at the office. We start with a three-month contract and hope you stay at least 12 months. We are flexible around exams and holidays.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You work directly with the Manager of IT Operational Excellence and get real responsibility from day one. Within your first three months, you will have delivered your first piece of reporting that the IT leadership team uses.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• Insight into how IT operations and continuous improvement work in an international retailer with more than 3,700 stores in 49 countries, more than 35,000 colleagues and an IT organisation of more than 400 people

• Room to shape your own role - this is a new area we are designing, and what you lean into will help define it

• A dedicated mentor, regular sparring and a network across IT that few students get

• Hands-on experience with ITIL, Lean, structured change management and the agile framework SAFe, which is how our teams work

• The option to use real cases for projects or your thesis

• Flexible hours that fit your studies and exams

• Engaged colleagues, a lunch programme with healthy and varied meals, and Friday bars

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

You help us turn improvements into results, and most of that happens in conversation with people. Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Data and insight: Collect and analyse data, build dashboards, and explain what the numbers show and how our initiatives are working.

• Following up on improvement actions: Keep track of our actions, check with the owners that they are delivered, and find out why when something stalls.

• Making larger initiatives easy to join: One example is our CMDB, a map of how applications and servers connect. You create templates, plan the steps with the teams and help remove what blocks them.

• Working with people: Talk to colleagues instead of hiding behind the screen. Join a stand-up, send a Slack message or walk over, and make it easy for people to help.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

You do not need experience. We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Is curious about data and what it tells you, with Excel as a good starting point

• Enjoys bringing structure to messy tasks

• Likes talking to people and following up until things get done

• Is motivated to learn, not least how IT runs a large retail business

• Is enrolled in a relevant higher education programme with at least 12 months of studies left

• Communicates fluently in English. Danish is a plus

• Can be at the office in Aarhus at least one day a week

Company Description

Are you motivated by shaping the future of JYSK through architectural direction rather than specific technologies? Can you inspire and coach teams to turn business ambitions into sustainable solutions? Do you thrive in the space between business and technology, translating strategic objectives into architectural guidance and helping others make sound decisions?

The technologies may change, but your passion for creating clear direction, strong collaboration, and sustainable architecture remains constant.

Are you experienced in within the domain of retail solutions and have a strong knowledge of what matters in software architecture within this domain?

Then you could be the one we are looking for!

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

In JYSK your official title will be Release Train Architect and you will shape the architecture within our retail domain and influence the broader direction across JYSK—all in an informal and collaborative environment.

JYSK has strong ambitions in omnichannel commerce for creating even better customer experiences across all our channels. With over 3,500 stores and more than 100 new openings each year, retail is a core part of our IT landscape.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• Sparring and feedback from skilled colleagues.

• A job where you get the opportunity to develop professionally and personally.

• A workplace in an exciting international company where results, expansion and development have a high priority.

• A relaxed and open minded atmosphere with rich opportunities to cooperate with colleagues at all levels of the organisation.

• Several social activities during the year, including Friday bars, DHL run, Christmas party etc.

• A healthy work-life balance as well as a strong company culture with a short distance from decision to action.

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As part of the leadership team for our Retail Excellence ART consisting of 7 product teams, you will play a key role as the main architect in shaping the architecture that supports JYSK stores and the retail capabilities that enable thousands of colleagues to serve customers every day. You will help guide the evolution of our store systems landscape, ensuring that solutions are sustainable, scalable, and aligned with both business objectives and architectural principles.

In this role, you will work closely with business leaders, product teams, engineers, and fellow architects to provide architectural direction, facilitate decision-making, and create alignment across the organization. You are not expected to be the technical expert in every solution. Instead, you are a leader, coach, and trusted sparring partner who enables others to make sound architectural decisions and translate business ambitions into valuable outcomes.

Reporting to our Senior Enterprise Architect you will join a team of three Enterprise Architects and five Release Train Architects.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Ensuring technical governance and architectural roadmap within the ART.

• Collaboration and alignment with architects and solution specialists across the organisation.

• Writing solution designs within the domain of our retail and store operations.

• Guiding teams to the right solutions and being a visible sparring partner.

• Being a central sparring partner with external vendor on the POS system, being able to translate between tech and business.

You can read more about our department at https://job.jysk.dk/dk/head-office/it

The current tech stack includes Enactor point of sales system, custom development using the Java and React development stacks, SAP S/4Hana ERP backend. In recent years we have modernised our landscape shifting towards a more headless and event driven architecture.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

In your architect role you understand the importance of stability and performance in the daily work of a store employee. This will require you understand the importance of time to market in the business of retail. Furthermore, you can navigate and cater your dialogue to all levels in the organisation both in business and IT.

You are driven by the architecture discipline itself, understanding how principles, governance, collaboration, and long-term thinking create business value with a focus on translating this into actionable actions.

You enjoy challenging assumptions, facilitating discussions, and influencing decisions that shape the foundation of JYSK's future growth and transformation.

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Has experience from an architect position and possess good understanding of the architecture domains (business, data, application, technology).

• Are proactive, independent and naturally drives the architectural agenda.

• Takes initiative and achieves results which are aligned with the strategic prioritisation.

• Naturally creates results through others and are hands-on when needed.

• Has a curious and open mindset.

• Can translate business initiatives into architectural roadmap for ART.

• Demonstrates excellent communication skills at all levels.

• Preferrable have experience from retail.

• Naturally feels comfortable in a leadership role

Additional Information

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Senior Enterprise Architect, Michael Nyholm Telling at +45 4012 4218

Title:
AI-augmented Physiological Modelling for Prediction and Mitigation of Heat Stress in Pigs

Research area and project description:
Heat stress is an increasing challenge to pig production and animal welfare, particularly during hot seasons. Effective mitigation requires not only the detection of elevated heat load, but also the ability to predict how animals respond dynamically and to determine when and how cooling interventions should be applied. Existing mechanistic thermal models provide an important basis for representing animal heat balance and physiological responses. However, their ability to incorporate real-time physiological observations, account for model assumptions and environmental stochasticity, and support timely intervention decisions remains limited. At the same time, purely data-driven black-box approaches are challenging to develop and validate when high-quality physiological datasets are limited, as is often the case in controlled animal experiments.

This PhD project aims to develop a physics-informed digital model for predicting and mitigating heat stress in pigs. Building on conventional mechanistic models of pig physiological responses, the project will investigate how physiological modelling can be combined with AI approaches to develop a more robust and interpretable representation of the pig’s thermal state. To further enhance the accessibility and practical use of the model, the project will also explore how large language models (LLMs) can be integrated with the physiological model to facilitate interactive exploration of model behaviour and predictions.

Qualifications and specific competences:
We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with:
• A MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related filed.
• A strong academic background and interest in HVAC systems in buildings, and fluid and thermal systems modelling.
• Proven experience in data analytics, machine learning, and optimisation.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in interdisciplinary teams.
• Excellent written and spoken English skills.It is considered an advantage if you have:
• Knowledge of animal heat stress and animal welfare.
• Knowledge of Large Language Model, stochastic modelling, system identification.

jobs.occupation: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
jobs.description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

·         Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
·         Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
·         General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.
 
We expect you to

·         Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
·         Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
·         Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
·         Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
·         Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
·         Not be afraid of getting dirty
·         Understand and speak English

Please note:
You must be an EU/EEA citizen. Applicants who do not meet this requirement should not apply.

Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
·         Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
·         Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
·         Start date: as soon as possible
·         Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle
·         Accommodation (a smaller apartment/room) can be arranged locally - expected rent approx. DKK 4,000-5,000 per month max
 
Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.

Are you passionate about GxP systems and digital transformation? And would you like to take ownership of an essential part of the IT and compliance strategy in an innovative pharma company?

If yes, Pharmacosmos is looking for a GxP Cloud Engineer to join the Global IT team.

Pharmacosmos is a global pharmaceutical company with headquarters in Holbæk, Denmark and subsidiaries in the USA, United Kingdom, Germany, and China. Fueled by rapid growth and supported by over 700 employees, we continue to embrace an entrepreneurial mindset, forging global partnerships to tackle pressing health challenges and improve patient outcomes worldwide. We have a collaborative and people-centric company culture rooted in our Danish heritage and built on quality, trust, and innovation.

About the department

Our Global IT department consists of 13 dedicated professionals, with 10 based at the headquarters in Holbæk. The department is structured into four focus areas: Helpdesk, Security, Application & Operation, and Strategic Projects. This role will join the Application & Operation team and serve as the primary internal expert on GxP-governed enterprise systems.

Global IT is on an exciting journey of modernization, transitioning from a traditional support function to a strategic enabler of digitalization, compliance, and operational excellence. You will work closely with colleagues across QA, Regulatory Affairs, laboratories, and IT.

About the job

We are now strengthening our internal ownership of GxP-governed IT systems – such as LIMS, TMF, and electronic document management systems – and digitalizing the way we work across QA, regulatory, and laboratory processes.

As GxP Cloud Engineer, you will take operational and strategic responsibility for these systems, ensuring they meet validation, documentation, and compliance requirements (e.g., GAMP5, FDA 21 CFR Part 11). You will also contribute to designing and implementing new systems as part of 8–10 major digitalization initiatives planned over the coming years.

This is a highly independent and impactful role with the opportunity to shape how Pharmacosmos governs and develops critical enterprise systems in a regulated environment.

The position reports to the Senior Director, Head of Global IT.

You key responsibilities will include:

• 
Operational ownership of existing GxP IT systems.

• 
System design and architecture for new digital solutions.

• 
Driving digitalization initiatives across QA, Regulatory, and Labs.

• 
Ensuring validation, documentation, and compliance (GAMP5, Part 11).

• 
Collaborating with stakeholders and external vendors.

• 
Defining and optimizing governance and processes.

• 
Acting as subject matter expert and advisor on IT/GxP matters.

About you

To thrive in this role, you bring:

• 
3+ years of experience with GxP IT systems (5+ years preferred).

• 
Experience with systems such as LIMS, TMF, or electronic document management.

• 
Knowledge of validation frameworks (e.g., GAMP5, Part 11).

• 
Understanding of documentation, SOPs, and risk assessments.

• 
Experience with cloud solutions is a plus, but GxP expertise is essential.

• 
A proactive and structured mindset with the ability to work independently.

• 
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• 
You thrive in a dynamic and quality-focused environment and are motivated by making a real impact across business-critical systems and processes.

Pharmacosmos offers

• 
A key role in a growing pharma company with high ambitions and strong values.

• 
An opportunity to shape how GxP systems are governed and developed.

• 
A collaborative and flexible work culture based in Holbæk.

• 
Competitive salary package incl. health insurance, lunch scheme.

• 
A global organization with an entrepreneurial and people-focused spirit.

Additional information

Your application and CV (in English) should be submitted using the link above. This recruitment is supported by Capax Recruitment. Please contact Line Kejser at lke@capax.dk or any questions about the recruitment.

**

About Pharmacosmos**

Pharmacosmos A/S is a global leader in carbohydrate chemistry and innovative treatments for iron deficiency and iron deficiency anaemia. Building on their foundational expertise in carbohydrate chemistry and cell cycle biology, they develop innovative treatments for unmet patient needs, with a focus on iron metabolism and blood-related disorders. Founded in 1965 and headquartered in Denmark, the team is made up of more than 700 specialists across the UK, Ireland, the Nordics, Germany, the USA, and China. Learn more about Pharmacosmos at www.pharmacosmos.com.

Ambitious and skilled Global BI Specialist to drive Business Intelligence excellence

Location: Holbæk and work from home

The company Pharmacosmos

Pharmacosmos is a family-owned, international pharmaceutical company and a global leader in the treatment of iron deficiency anaemia. Headquartered in Holbæk, Denmark, the company employs more than 650 people worldwide with subsidiaries across Europe, the US, and Asia. Pharmacosmos is experiencing continued growth and is in the midst of an ongoing digital transformation, where data and insights play a key role in supporting decision-making across the organisation.

Your role

As a Global BI Specialist, you will play a central role in strengthening Pharmacosmos’ Business Intelligence capabilities within Finance & IT – Data & Projects. Your primary responsibility will be to ensure that high-quality data and actionable insights support decision-making across the organisation.

The role is an end-to-end BI position, covering both backend data platform work and frontend reporting, combined with close collaboration with stakeholders across the business. You will work across the full BI and data stack – from Azure Data Factory pipelines and SQL-based data models to reports and dashboards consumed globally.

You will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimising the BI and data platform, translating complex business requirements into scalable and value-creating BI solutions. Close collaboration with internal stakeholders and external BI consultants is a key part of the role, ensuring that requirements are clarified, challenged when necessary, and implemented in a robust and future-proof manner.

You will join Data & Projects, a small and highly specialised team within Finance & IT. The team consists of a Director, a Project Manager, and two Global BI Specialists and holds overall responsibility for Pharmacosmos’ BI and data platform.

The team culture is professional, collaborative, and informal, with a strong focus on knowledge sharing, sparring, and flexibility – including the option to work from home as needed.

Who you are

You are proactive, structured, and value-driven in your approach to BI and data. You thrive in roles with open-ended challenges, where requirements evolve through dialogue rather than fixed specifications. You take ownership of your work, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and focus on delivering solutions that create real business value.

You are pragmatic and operationally minded, yet able to think strategically and contribute to continuous improvements of the BI and data platform.

Your skills and experience are within

• Advanced user of Microsoft Power BI

• Proficient in SQL, capable of working in SSMS

• Familiar with ETL pipelines/integration/workflows (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Logic Apps, Azure Functions, etc.)

• Analytical skills – you can dive into new problem areas and data domains and understand the architecture and data flows

• Motivated by improving business performance with insights from data

• Experience working with Microsoft Dynamics (Axapta, 365 BC or 365 F&O) data would be an advantage

• Advanced skills in Excel would be an advantage

Specific requirements

• Fluency in spoken and written English

• Danish resident

Personal competencies

You must be a naturally proactive person. You seek excellent solutions to large and small issues that you yourself continually identify – and you always work with a focus on delivering value.

You deal very well with open-ended ideas/problems. This means that you do not require a fixed written requirements specification – because none such can be provided. Rather, you thrive in a collaborative team where ideas are brainstormed informally, after which you drive the implementation of the project, report, or fix.

You are a self-driven and systematic individual with a keen eye for detail, always seeking ways to enhance the data platform and processes. Your robust interpersonal skills enable you to collaborate effectively with others, having natural authority while maintaining an easy-going demeanor.

With excellent analytical skills and an open-minded approach to communication, combined with your natural ability to connect with others, you adeptly tackle complex challenges.

You are known for your strong sense of accountability, consistently delivering on agreements in a timely manner. You align to agreed priorities and execute swiftly.

You are a pragmatic and operationally minded thinker, always seeking practical solutions to challenges.

Additional Information

Place of work is Pharmacosmos HQ in Holbæk. Flexible work from home opportunities can be arranged with the direct manager. Limited travel may be required (5–10 days per year). This position offers strong opportunities for professional development as Pharmacosmos continues its digital transformation and global expansion.

Contact and Application

Applications and interviews are handled on an ongoing basis. Early application is recommended.

This recruitment process is handled by Capax Recruitment. Please feel free to contact Benedikte Berg Heinild at bhe@capax.dk with questions about the position. Applications can be submitted in both Danish and English.

Become a key link in Pharmacosmos’ global value chain

Do you thrive in a dynamic and international Supply Chain where structure, coordination, and continuous improvement are essential? Are you motivated by playing a central role in ensuring efficient and compliant supply chain processes? If so, you might be the new Supply Chain Specialist to join their headquarters at Pharmacosmos in Holbæk. Reporting to Senior Product Supply Manager you will be part of a global Supply Chain team.

Here, you will take responsibility for day-to-day execution while also helping to build and improve processes and systems in line with their growth journey.

About Pharmacosmos and the department

Pharmacosmos is a global pharmaceutical company in significant growth, delivering more than 20 percent annual growth in recent years. Headquartered in Holbæk, they also have subsidiaries in the US, Germany, the UK, and China. More than 650 colleagues worldwide work together to develop innovative treatments within iron deficiency and related diseases.

As a Supply Chain Specialist at Pharmacosmos, you will become part of a strong and collaborative team that works closely with contract manufacturers, QA, production, customer service, and sales across both Denmark and international markets.

The Supply Chain department manages planning, sourcing, and material flows for both raw materials and finished goods, and is characterized by a dynamic and supportive culture with flat structures and broad responsibilities, giving you the chance to make a visible impact. Collaboration across functions is at the core of how they work, and you will contribute not only to daily operations but also to ongoing improvement initiatives and cross-functional projects.

The role

As Supply Chain Specialist, you will play a central role in the daily execution of supply chain activities within a GMP-regulated environment. You will act as a key link across the value chain, working closely with QA, production, customer service, sales, international contract manufacturers, and affiliates.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Taking operational responsibility for selected CMO partners in Europe and the US, including coordination, troubleshooting, and follow-up through regular meetings

• Handling order flow, purchasing, and supplier interactions while ensuring compliance with GMP standards

• Supporting affiliates with planning, reconciliations, and alignment of local needs

• Acting as a link between internal and external stakeholders to secure alignment and efficient collaboration

• Maintaining accurate and up-to-date master data in ERP, including BOMs and recipes

• Contributing to process improvements, ERP implementation, and cross-functional projects

A crucial part of the role is contributing to Pharmacosmos’ digital transformation. You will work with data-driven decision-making, support the implementation of a new ERP system, and help automate processes to create a more scalable and future-ready supply chain. With your analytical mindset and strong Excel skills, you will have the opportunity to make a visible impact.

Your profile

Pharmacosmos is looking for a candidate who enjoys hands-on supply chain work and at the same time wants to contribute to improvements and development. You bring a strong operational mindset, solid ERP understanding, and thrive in a structured yet fast-paced environment. You understand the importance of compliance and documentation and have a proactive and service-minded approach to problem-solving.

To succeed in the role, you should bring:

• Minimum three years of experience in supply chain or production planning, preferably within a GMP-regulated industry such as pharmaceuticals, life science, or food

• Solid experience with ERP systems (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar)

• Good understanding of the interfaces between production, QA, and supply chain

• Strong Excel skills and a data-driven approach

• Fluency in Danish, both written and spoken, and professional English communication skills

• Relevant education within supply chain or a related field is considered an advantage

It will be an advantage if you have experience with process optimization or system implementation.

Pharmacosmos offers

At Pharmacosmos, you will step into a central role in a growing company where you can develop both operationally and professionally. You will experience broad responsibility in a flat organization, close collaboration with skilled colleagues and international partners, and a culture built on trust, ownership, and professionalism.

Pharmacosmos offers a competitive salary and benefits package, with your daily base at their production site in Holbæk.

Application

Are you ready to take part in Pharmacosmos’ digital transformation and help further develop their infrastructure? Then send your application today.

This recruitment is assisted by Capax Recruitment. If you would like to hear more about the position, please contact Vjollca Muaremi at vmu@capax.dk.
